title: Capability: use_item enforces printed equipment prerequisites
description: Selected under the user's 2026-10-12 rule (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent): this structure stays TYPED in the SRD pack because a positive engine capability is more likely than not in the near future, so the capability must exist before the re-freeze (eshyra-o9bd.14). Capability contract per ADR 0020 / eshyra-olc5: operation, inputs, exclusions, residual DM interpretation, real binding to the pack fields, provider-neutral execution, state effects, conformance tests exercising the PACK representation, fail-closed for unsupported input. Pack shape is owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (PR #656); coordinate field shapes with it rather than changing the pack later. Scope: a structured activation equipment prerequisite (worn / held / attuned / on-person, possibly several) introduced by #656 is checked by use_item against inventory wear, custody and attunement state (wear_item, attune_item, itemState), refusing with a clear reason when unmet; property-level attunement (e.g. Hammer of Thunderbolts' Giant's Bane) distinct from item-level requiresAttunement.
notes:
STOP CONDITION (user, 2026-10-12): if any KEPT-typed category (economies incl. event anchors, action type, structured equipment prerequisites, kept state machines/duration toggles, grant creature/count/duration/reversion) or any capability bead eshyra-olc5.8-.12 turns out to be particularly difficult to verify in a way that makes convergence unlikely (e.g. repeated review findings in the same kept category, or verification that cannot distinguish faithful from unfaithful cheaply), the captain must SURFACE it to the user with evidence before proceeding - do not keep repairing it and do not silently reclassify it as DM-adjudicated.
Pack shape fixed in PR #656 (captain, 2026-10-13): activation.equipment is DISJUNCTIVE NORMAL FORM - an array of alternatives, each an array of required states (worn|held|attuned|on-person). Permitted when ANY ONE alternative holds; an alternative holds when ALL its states hold. [['held']] = held; [['worn'],['held']] = the printed 'wearing or holding it' (both alignment talismans' open-fissure). 124 operations typed (78 held, 38 worn, 3 attuned, 3 on-person, 2 worn-or-held). Validator: magicItemMechanics.ts; derivation: magicItemTriage.ts equipmentFromPrintedText. Bind to this shape; do not change the pack.
